node.statement: Quantitative nonvanishing: let C_PQR and e_PQR be the universal constants from lem-extcb-one-dimensional-product and set e_0=min(e_PQR,1/(2(C_PQR+1))). If e=delta+epsilon<=e_0, P is one-dimensional, and X,Y are nonzero elements of S_{P,Q}, then X^dagger dot Y is nonzero in S_Q.
